action_summary: Round 5 convicted the typography parser (2 of 7 rooms agreed with the program's own answer), so this round demoted it to an INDEX and made the MACHINE the definition: every candidate token is executed beside a control of the same shape in a throwaway clone, and a token is DEFINED only when no meaningless token produces the same observation. Four outcomes are possible and all four are measurements: MOVES_STATE, DEFINED, NOT_DEFINED, BLIND (with the reason printed). The page is also allowed to name its own way of asking: `bash --help` says "Type `bash -c help' for more information about shell builtin commands", the form was learned from that sentence and run, and the shell's index went from 1 token to 64 -- the round's cleanest win. On four programs no round of this project had touched (chosen from PATH by a stated rule) the index's precision is 0.704 at 106 probes and 0.6 s. The cell claim (a program's family decides how it is asked) was tested by holding out one program per cell: 1 of 3 transfers correct, and the two failures are structural (sh and more publish no alphabet in any form tried), reported as failures. Twelve distinct defects were found by running the instrument, each of which had produced a plausible number first; the most instructive are that substituting the candidate token inside the output rewrote `alpha` into `alp<T>a` for one-character candidates, and that grading a probe by its text read `sh -c help` -> `help: not found` as 'no command table'.
honest_limits: No benchmark score: OSWorld 2.1, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and SWE-bench Pro V2 cannot execute here (no browser, no X, no container runtime). They remain non-claims.
MOVES_STATE was never produced: no verified definition with a visible file effect was found this round, and the field is empty in the receipt.
The cell label is coarse by one axis: a shell answering `-c help` and a tool answering `--help` both land in OPTION_TABLE.
sh and more define nothing in any form tried; their rooms report UNPROVEN rather than an invented alphabet.
The held-out bank (tar, grep, find, openssl, git, python3, vim) is named and was NOT run.
One machine, one geometry, one implementation, producer-run only.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Three routes were measured and rejected this round rather than argued. (1) Grading a probe by what its text says: `sh -c help` answers `help: not found` and a round-3 instrument read that as a shell with no command table; a probe is graded by a differential against a shape-matched control, never by text. (2) Keeping the typography parser as the DECIDER: round 5 measured 2 of 7 agreement with the program's own answer, so it survives only as an INDEX whose precision is measured (0.704 on four unseen programs). (3) Reviewing the room with the probe: files the probe can read came back in the observation (`No such file: alpha.txt`) and the differential compared rooms instead of programs; the room is now sealed exec-only and each probe gets its own clone.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only: 15 pins (14 pass, 1 expected failure) and one end-to-end receipt over seven rooms in 5.6 s. The headline claim fails in 5 of 7 rooms and is reported as failing. No independent identity has re-run any of it.

obs_layers_evaluated.1_the_real_goal: A general problem-solving system whose producer path is its own; no benchmark score is claimed because none is runnable here.
obs_layers_evaluated.2_the_current_blocker: Deciding what a program's commands ARE without decoding its prose. Answer: do not decode it -- execute each candidate against a shape-matched control and let the machine decide.
obs_layers_evaluated.3_the_challenger_frontier: Rejected this round: text-graded probes, the typography parser as decider, a readable room, a shared room, six-line signatures, universal-forms-only indexing, JSON-by-line-count, first-word command trees, absolute paths across the trial boundary.
obs_layers_evaluated.4_volatile_dependency_preflight: Zero network, zero model calls, zero incremental spend; the only dependencies are the programs on this machine and a throwaway clone per probe.
obs_layers_evaluated.5_the_route_race: Execution beat both parsing and prose: the index is 0.704 precise and the probe is exact, and the page's own taught form (-c help) unlocked the 62 builtins that three universal forms could not reach.
obs_layers_evaluated.6_the_receipt: This file plus canonical/verification/THE_MACHINE_IS_THE_DEFINITION_20261124_V1.json (8 rooms, 808 probes, 78.8 s) and ..._CELLS_20261124_V1.json (4 cells, 3 transfers, 39.7 s).
obs_layers_evaluated.7_the_decision: KEEP the index-then-probe pipeline and the taught-form reader; DECLARE the next blocker: the cell label needs the axis 'what the alphabet is', not only 'how it was reached', and the held-out bank must be run before any transfer claim is repeated.
